d: Hav Hangpan Dada was born in village Borduria , near Khonsa in district Tirap of Arunachal Pradesh .Hav Dada was from Assam Regiment . He was always known as a soft spoken,God fearing gentleman with resolute will, daring courage and sharp soldierly skills to his friends.Driven by his deep calling for adventure and challenging operational life ,he volunteered to serve in Rashtriya Rifles.
